hero.title: We train artists for the stage
hero.subtitle: Acting, dance and stage creation in a rigorous, contemporary and deeply human education project.

acting.title: Acting
acting.desc: A comprehensive training to develop presence, voice, body and imagination. Explore text, creation and collaborative practice with rigor, curiosity and a commitment to the stage.

dance.title: Dance
dance.desc: Train technique, musicality and body awareness to turn movement into language. Combine ballet, contemporary dance, jazz and choreographic creation.

creation.title: Stage creation
creation.desc: Directing, production and stage thinking to imagine and sustain your own works.

faculty.heading: Our faculty
faculty.desc: Active artists, researchers and teachers whose practice was forged on stages in Mexico, Cuba and Europe.

about.heading: About OKAN
about.text: A performing arts institution that brings together training, artistic research and human support to shape the next generation of creators.

programs.heading: Academic programs
programs.intro: Three performing arts degrees built on comprehensive, hands-on training grounded in the contemporary stage.

acting.title: Acting
acting.desc: A curriculum that brings together actor training, dramaturgy, voice, movement and stage laboratory, with a contemporary lean and critical thinking.

dance.title: Dance
dance.desc: Technical training in ballet, contemporary dance and jazz, alongside movement research, body awareness and choreographic creation.

creation.title: Stage creation
creation.desc: Directing, production and stage thinking to imagine, sustain and produce your own works with an interdisciplinary approach.

admissions.heading: Admissions
admissions.intro: We want to get to know you. Our process looks for talent, curiosity and commitment — not a perfect record.

steps.title: Application
steps.desc: Complete your online application with your details and background.

steps.title: Audition
steps.desc: Present a sample of your work before our faculty.

steps.title: Interview
steps.desc: We talk about your motivation and your path.

steps.title: Result
steps.desc: You receive the admission decision and next steps.

life.heading: Student life
life.intro: A community where learning goes beyond the classroom: rehearsals, productions, collaborations and support.

features.title: Stages
features.desc: Take part in productions and showcases throughout your training.

features.title: Community
features.desc: A close faculty and classmates who become colleagues.

features.title: Support
features.desc: Psycho-pedagogy and wellbeing woven into the creative process.

features.title: Collaborations
features.desc: Interdisciplinary projects across acting, dance and creation.

about.heading: About OKAN
about.intro: We are a school of the arts dedicated to training whole performing artists, with a rigorous and deeply human education project.
about.missionText: To develop each student's individual potential, shaping curious, critical and socially-conscious creators through teaching of excellence.
about.storyText: OKAN was born from the sustained work of artists and teachers committed to professional training in the performing arts, joining technical rigor with research and human support.

values.title: Excellence
values.desc: Technical rigor and artistic discipline in every process.

values.title: Humanism
values.desc: We care for the person behind the artist.

values.title: Research
values.desc: The stage as a space for thinking and creation.
